summary: Phase 13 DESTRUCTIVE reset (POST /api/admin/admin/danger/reset-all-data) tested end-to-end on PREVIEW. 13/14 backend pytest passed + UI flow verified after I fixed a missing multipart header in AdminUsers.jsx. Two real bugs found.

minor.issue: ADMIN_ROLES set in /app/backend/auth_utils.py:119 is missing 'admin_marketing'. seed.py:93 seeds 4 sub-admins INCLUDING admin_marketing. The reset query {role: {$nin: ADMIN_ROLES + [SUPER_ADMIN]}} therefore DELETES the admin_marketing user every run, then reseed re-creates it. Net effect: reset is not truly idempotent for admin_marketing — `users_deleted_non_admin: 1` on every subsequent run instead of 0. Fix: add 'admin_marketing' to ADMIN_ROLES set in auth_utils.py.

ui_bugs.issue: FormData posted to /admin/admin/danger/reset-all-data was sent with the global axios `Content-Type: application/json` header (api/client.js:9) → FastAPI form parser failed with 422 'Field required'. Reset modal never resolved in UI. FIXED by passing `{ headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } }` (matches pattern in Withdraw.jsx, RoyaltyImport.jsx, Migrate.jsx).

issues: Review mentions navigation to /admin/users; actual mounted route is /admin/admin-users (App.js:95). Not a bug, just a doc nit.

action_items: BACKEND (1 line): In /app/backend/auth_utils.py line 119 add 'admin_marketing' to ADMIN_ROLES set so it isn't wiped by reset (and so test_phase13's test_d1 idempotent assertion turns green).
Optional: also include admin_marketing in routes/cms.py admin_role gates if you want it to use CMS; not required for reset correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: ADMIN_ROLES drift: seed.py seeds 4 sub-admin roles but auth_utils.ADMIN_ROLES only lists 3 of them — admin_marketing is orphaned. Same bug would affect any other endpoint using require_admin (it works because require_admin checks against ADMIN_ROLES; admin_marketing currently has NO admin powers despite being seeded as one).
AdminUsers.jsx submitReset() omitted multipart header — easy regression. Recommend a tiny helper `apiForm.post(url, fd)` to wrap multipart calls and avoid repeating the header literal in 5+ places.
Reset endpoint correctly paginates R2 deletes in batches of 1000 ✓. Reseed-after-reset works ✓. Activity log entry written ✓.

Phase 13 test data still shows ~10 'TEST Adm' admin users from earlier iterations that the reset DOES preserve (they have role=admin_release/admin_finance). Consider letting super_admin bulk-delete these test sub-admin accounts via an extra UI button.

rca_of_admin_marketing_bug: Reset query uses ADMIN_ROLES (set in auth_utils.py:119) to decide which users to preserve. ADMIN_ROLES = {super_admin, admin_release, admin_finance, admin_support, admin_content}. seed.py:93 inserts an admin_marketing sub-admin which is NOT in this set. Result: every reset deletes admin_marketing, reseed recreates it, next reset deletes it again — endless 1-user delta. Fix: add 'admin_marketing' (and 'admin_content' if not seeded — currently it IS in ADMIN_ROLES but NOT seeded, which is the inverse half of the same drift) to keep seed.py and auth_utils.py in sync.
